scope: Targeted Phase 5 extraction from official Shadows over Innistrad / Eldritch Moon web fiction: I Am Avacyn, Campaign of Vengeance, Innistrad's Last Hope and The Promised End. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; not owner approved.

claims.subject: sorin_markov

quotes.quote: He was there when I was created, the man who stood over me that first instant when I came into being.
"You created me to ensure that all wickedness meets its demise," I say.

claims.summary: Sorin Markov created Avacyn as Innistrad's protector.
claims.limitation: Narrated in Avacyn's own first-person voice.

claims.subject: sorin_markov

quotes.quote: Fumes rose from the burnt place on the floor, drifting up through shafts of light from one of the cathedral's skylights. Avacyn was no more.

claims.summary: Sorin unmade Avacyn with a reversed ritual, revoking the gift that made her.

claims.subject: sorin_markov

quotes.quote: Sorin Markov, I condemn you as the greatest evil of this world.

claims.summary: Maddened, Avacyn condemned Sorin as the greatest evil of Innistrad before he unmade her.
claims.limitation: Avacyn's condemnation came during her madness.

claims.subject: nahiri

quotes.quote: The stone tightened in on him until it had him in its grasp.
And the next moment, Nahiri planeswalked away from Innistrad, leaving Sorin to the fate of his world.

claims.summary: At Markov Manor, Nahiri encased Sorin in stone and planeswalked away.

claims.subject: nahiri

quotes.quote: Thanks to Nahiri's machinations, the Eldrazi titan Emrakul has been unleashed on Innistrad.

claims.summary: Nahiri's machinations unleashed Emrakul on Innistrad.
claims.limitation: The page's lead-in summary credits her 'machinations'; the mechanism is told elsewhere.

claims.subject: olivia_voldaren

quotes.quote: "Even if I could, why? Avacyn is dead. Nahiri has been driven off. Our bargain is fulfilled." She chuckled cruelly.
I rather like the sound of 'Olivia, Lord of Innistrad.'

claims.summary: Olivia refused to free the imprisoned Sorin once their bargain was fulfilled, taking his sword.

claims.subject: tamiyo

quotes.quote: Not the Helvault, Tamiyo responded. Where the Helvault came from. The moon. A silver moon. I have a binding spell.
In that moon's depths was the most powerful and destructive force any of them had ever encountered.

claims.summary: Tamiyo's binding spell, linked to Emrakul with Jace's help, bound Emrakul inside Innistrad's silver moon.
claims.limitation: The binding was a group effort (Jace attached the spell, and the text turns to Nissa for its power).

claims.subject: emrakul

quotes.quote: In that moon's depths was the most powerful and destructive force any of them had ever encountered.

claims.summary: After The Promised End, Emrakul is held in the depths of Innistrad's moon.

claims.subject: liliana_vess

quotes.quote: She was now a member of the Gatewatch. Futures unfolded in her mind, full of promise and ambition.

claims.summary: Liliana swore an oath and joined the Gatewatch after Emrakul was bound.
claims.limitation: Her oath was partly insincere by her own account.

remaining: The other 17 SOI/EMN episodes (Markov Manor mystery, Thraben, Gisela/Bruna, Tamiyo's journal) are not extracted
Avacyn's madness and its cause (Nahiri, Emrakul) need the earlier episodes
